title: Mass Varying Neutrino Oscillation in Teleparallel Gravity
summary: In the Cartan teleparallel formulation of gravity, a scalar field coupled to the torsion tensor can acquire an environment dependent effective mass. This gives rise to a screening effect: Inside dense bodies such as the Sun, the scalar field is suppressed, causing the mass varying neutrino mass to vary with local density. We investigate the impact of this torsion-induced screening on solar neutrino oscillations.
